source.datasetTitle: Demoulding behaviour of material jetted surfaces
source.companionStudy: Investigating demoulding characteristics of material jetted rapid mould inserts for microinjection moulding using in-line monitoring and surface metrology

measurementChain.sensorLocation: behind the ejector/measurement pin at the centre of the circular cavity
measurementChain.dataAcquisition: NI cDAQ-9174 with NI 9215 voltage input module
measurementChain.derivedQuantity: demoulding energy derived/integrated from force data in the study

originViewerLane.availableUse: A pre-existing local free Origin Viewer can inspect current OPJU files and export visible active-sheet data for non-counting reconciliation.
originViewerLane.reason: Origin Viewer is useful for extraction but cannot establish all Origin project semantics; OriginLab documents Viewer limitations including unsupported worksheet cell formulas. Viewer evidence alone therefore cannot distinguish every direct/derived field with promotion-grade certainty.

originExportAcceptance: For promotion, export all five named verified OPJU projects using a validated Windows Origin/OriginPro workflow.
Preserve project, workbook, worksheet/matrix and trial identity in the export manifest.
Identify direct force waveforms separately from formulas, derived columns and integrated demoulding-energy outputs.
Preserve source time/order and verify the 10 kHz sampling basis where the waveform is present.
Record exported units and any voltage-to-force conversion metadata contained in the Origin project; do not reconstruct conversion solely from the paper if the project contains its own scaling.
Reconcile exported row, column, channel and trial counts against each source OPJU project.
Fingerprint every exported table and map it to the original OPJU SHA-256.
Retain aggregate profiles only in the public repository unless the dataset licence and project policy explicitly permit raw redistribution.
boundary: Companion-study moulding settings are study-specific context and must not be promoted into universal production setpoints, validated process windows or machine/mould/material limits. Accepted sample counts remain zero until all five named OPJU projects are actually exported, reconciled and pass the promotion-grade Origin/OriginPro validator. Origin Viewer may reduce extraction work but remains a zero-count evidence lane.
